end.summary:
- Practised sorting small numbers as odd or even by making pairs.
- Jiya correctly identified 7 and 13 as odd using pairs.
- Practised using the ones digit to decide whether a number is odd or even.
- Jiya continued to use any odd digit, such as 3 in 34, to classify the whole number as odd.
- Teach-back was not passed; the ones-digit rule was not yet secured.
end.parentNote: Jiya practised making pairs to identify odd numbers and correctly explained why 7 and 13 leave one unpaired. They also worked on the ones-digit rule, but mixed up the role of other digits and continued to call 34 odd because it contains 3; this was not corrected by the end of the lesson. At home, practise sorting two-digit numbers by looking only at the final digit, using examples such as 24, 31, 46, and 53.
